_comment: READ BEFORE CHANGING floorHeight OR gapBetweenFloors.
Their sum is the floor-to-floor PITCH (10 + 2 = 12), which is the exact distance every
entrance and transition template Dungeons2 ships was cut for. Change the pitch and you must
author your own: stairs_1 and ladder1 carry their two door markers 12 apart and cannot be
stretched, the stairs_2 chain only lands on multiples of 6, and the entrance's bottom door
marker DEFINES floor 0's walking plane, so a taller floor puts floor 0's ceiling above the
entrance chamber's own. Nothing here is a tuning knob you can turn and walk away from.
Watch the log for [D2-PITCH] and [D2-SPAN]. Every other field in this file is safe to tune.
